title: kbmon's Needs-you disk line compares the rounded free_pct, so 9.96% free shows no line and a 0-byte total shows a false one
goal: mon_needs.disk_entries lists the disk line when the unrounded free share (free_bytes over total_bytes) is under 10% and never for a file system that reports a total of 0 bytes, as mon_host.alerts does

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_needs as m;a=m.disk_entries({'disk':{'free_pct':10.0,'free_bytes':996,'total_bytes':10000}});b=m.disk_entries({'disk':{'free_pct':0.0,'free_bytes':0,'total_bytes':0}});sys.exit(0 if len(a)==1 and b==[] else 1)
